I found 61 rectangular surfaces and one unsupported L-bracket. Next I’ll check occlusion and boundary readability.

## Conclusion

**Finite pool only:** SCENE, TOP, LEFT, RIGHT, FRONT and BACK, using the current geometry/material and actual current frames.

- **61 supported rectangular surfaces:** **18 covered**, **43 unknown**.
- Unknown comprises **10 with no front-facing candidate** and **33 occluded in every front-facing candidate**.
- **No surfaces remain unknown because of insufficient evidence.**
- One connected, nonrectangular component is retained as unsupported.

Coverage uses whole-surface geometric visibility—not merely visible raster pixels. Occlusion was checked with exact rational projected geometry. Boundary counts merge each surface’s source triangles and count unique target-owned endpoints of horizontal/vertical different-surface pairs with RGB distance ≥24.
